lithophane-table-lamp.name: Custom Cylindrical Lithophane Table Lamp
lithophane-table-lamp.description: Turn a favourite photograph into a warm, dimensional light. The cylindrical shade appears as an elegant embossed white sculpture when unlit, then reveals the image through soft light and shadow when switched on.
lithophane-table-lamp.leadTime: Made to order. Allow 4–6 business days before shipping.
lithophane-table-lamp.details:
Base and cylinder diameter: 100 mm
Approximate overall height: 230 mm
Wooden base with warm-white internal LED
USB power with inline switch
Fine 0.12 mm layer height for photographic detail
